programmes.specialization: Industrial Engineering and Management research field
programmes.evidence: Opened current LUT Doctoral School application guidance explicitly enumerates Industrial Engineering and Management as a formal research field within the Doctoral Programme in Engineering Science; the research field is specified in the doctoral study application and dissertation. Official degree inventory names Doctor of Science (Technology), and states doctoral dissertation and public defense requirements.

researchDoctorateEvidence.evidence: Official doctoral education page lists exact Doctor of Science (Technology) credential and requires an original dissertation defended in public examination.

limitations: Formal research-field title, not a separately awarded Doctor of Science in Industrial Engineering and Management; only one doctoral route counted.

branches.conclusion: Current central doctoral admissions inventory lists Business and Management doctorate with Economics and Business Administration fields only; no separate named Operations/Management Science field in the complete central field enumeration.

Current central admissions and doctoral degree inventory enumerate doctoral programmes and fields across Energy Systems and Engineering Science; Industrial Engineering and Management is the qualifying formal Engineering Science research field. Generic Energy Systems fields are not title matches.

sources.note: Full current rolling-admissions doctorate page explicitly enumerates all three doctoral programmes and formal research fields, IEM among Engineering Science fields.
Full central degree inventory with exact Doctor of Science (Technology) award, all formal fields, dissertation and public defense qualification.

limitations: Current central doctoral field inventory complete for named-title scope; detailed nonmatching research projects were not separately counted.
